title: fit_text
description: Make a shape's text fit its box: shrinks it, as PowerPoint's "shrink text on overflow" does (never below 14 pt), or else makes the box taller into free space below it. For text that does not fit after an edit; when neither can, the result says so.

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first, as the deck map and the person say it) or its ID.
